summary: Nex Core reconcile keeps an interrupted operation's journal status pending while its resume runs (delete, create start, firmware removal, Secure Boot variables and definition), so a mid-way save no longer persists a provisional needs_attention. A result still unsettled at the end becomes needs_attention with its reason, or the retained-operation message when no reason was recorded. A resumed create now records succeeded after its start step instead of before it. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: Operator behavior is unchanged: docs/guide/delete-virtual-machine.md already says a pending delete task is finished by Nex Core. The fix removes a transient needs_attention that the guide never described.

api.reason: docs/API.md is listed as the governing reference and needs no edit: the managed command result and host inventory keep their existing statuses (pending, succeeded, failed, needs_attention) and fields. Only the persisted status of an entry mid-resume changes from needs_attention to pending, which the Controller and Core reconcilers already treat as unresolved in the same way. No endpoint, field, or version negotiation changes.

roadmap.reason: Defect fix from the Phase 2 gate; no milestone changes.

state.record: The operation's entry in the host's Nex Core managed journal (the state directory's <operation_id>.json). A fresh Controller reads the result through the existing host inventory and adoption path.
state.reason: Only the status value Core writes during recovery changes. No new record is added and nothing is kept in the Controller.

verification.method: Added TestResumedDeleteMidwaySaveStaysPending: the fake virsh list call copies del-1.json after the wiping-stage save. Before the fix it failed with status needs_attention; after the fix it passes. TestInterruptedDeleteRefusesRunningDomain still ends needs_attention with its reason. Ran go test -race ./internal/vmhost/... ./internal/agent/..., go vet and gofmt. No lab or hardware verification was run.
